problems.issue: The URL redirects to a Facebook login wall and browser incompatibility interstitial instead of showing the dental clinic's public business information.
problems.impact: Potential patients cannot view clinic details, hours, reviews, or contact information, leading to immediate abandonment.

problems.issue: Heavy reliance on a social media platform as the primary digital storefront, resulting in complete visibility loss when access is restricted.
problems.impact: Loss of control over customer acquisition and brand presence.

opportunities: Develop a dedicated, independent business website to maintain full control over patient acquisition and brand presentation.
Implement local SEO strategies (Google Business Profile) to capture high-intent local dental search traffic.
Add clear call-to-action features like online booking and direct contact numbers prominently on all digital touchpoints.
audit.summary: The analyzed URL fails to deliver business information due to platform login walls and browser compatibility errors. Transitioning to an independent, professional website will ensure reliable patient reach and better conversion opportunities.

outreach.subject: Quick thought on Smile & Style's website
outreach.body:
Hi there,

I was looking up Smile & Style Dental Clinic online today and noticed your main link currently sends visitors straight to a Facebook login wall and compatibility error. 

When prospective patients hit that roadblock instead of your hours, reviews, and services, many unfortunately just move on to another clinic. Relying solely on social media for your storefront means losing control when platforms gate your info.

We actually put together a quick, clean live demo of what an independent site could look like for you. 

Would it be useful if I sent it over?

Best,
Rahul

---

outreach.subject: Quick thought on the Novodental Robinsons Manila site
outreach.body:
Hi there,

I was just looking over your clinic's site while checking out dental options around Manila, and I really like how clean your layout is. 

I did notice a couple of technical hiccups under the hood, though—specifically, some older framework versions and scripts loading synchronously in the head. That combination can slow down load times on mobile, which unfortunately leads folks to bounce before they even see your booking info.

We put together a quick, lightweight demo of an improved version to fix those bottlenecks. Would it be useful if I sent it over?

Best,
Rahul
